mapper.sql: run_record_id AS runRecordId, runner_id AS runnerId, run_datetime AS runDatetime, run_date AS runDate, duration_sec AS durationSec, distance_km AS distanceKm, avg_pace_sec AS avgPaceSec, avg_hr AS avgHr, training_type_code AS trainingTypeCode, rpe, temperature, humidity, weather_code AS weatherCode, memo, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RUN_RECORD ( runner_id, run_datetime, run_date, duration_sec, distance_km, avg_pace_sec, avg_hr, training_type_code, rpe, temperature, humidity, weather_code, memo, created_at ) VALUES ( #{runnerId}, #{runDatetime}, #{runDate}, #{durationSec}, #{distanceKm}, #{avgPaceSec}, #{avgHr}, #{trainingTypeCode}, #{rpe}, #{temperature}, #{humidity}, #{weatherCode}, #{memo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE RUN_RECORD SET run_datetime = #{runDatetime}, run_date = #{runDate}, duration_sec = #{durationSec}, distance_km = #{distanceKm}, avg_pace_sec = #{avgPaceSec}, avg_hr = #{avgHr}, training_type_code = #{trainingTypeCode}, rpe = #{rpe}, temperature = #{temperature}, humidity = #{humidity}, weather_code = #{weatherCode}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE run_record_id = #{runRecordId} AND runner_id = #{runnerId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM RUN_RECORD WHERE run_record_id = #{runRecordId} AND runner_id = #{runnerId}
